scientific.integrity: The motivating full text, a direct predecessor, and later slow-fast work on the same model family were inspected. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker verifies the source-compatible witness. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The straight stable manifold occurs on a codimension-one parameter surface. It is not claimed to be the complete global boundary of all attraction basins.

title: An exact invariant-ray stable manifold in the density-dependent ratio predator-prey model
